title: Grateful Dead Live at Richmond Coliseum on 1985-11-01
lineage: Nakamichi DR-1 > Korg MR-1 > DSF [1-bit 2.8 MHz Stereo] Rate Conversion: Korg AudioGate to WAV [24/96] Mastering in WaveLab with iZotope Ozone 3 (eq) and Waves L3 Multimaximizer > CD WAVE > TLH > Flac
source: 2x Sennheiser 421 > Sony TC-D5 > Sony TC-D5 Master Cassettes Maxell MX-90's Location: FOB, 20' from stage.  Center patched out of Steve Adleman.

ai_review.summary: Superb performance captured on a superior recording that outshines the official release.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this concert as one of the best they ever witnessed, highlighting electrifying moments like Little Red Rooster, Jack Straw and the soaring Saint opener, plus seamless transitions from Dancing In The Streets to a powerful Gloria closer. The tape is praised for its clarity and vivid audience presence, making it sound better than the official issue.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and emphasize both an outstanding show and a recording that surpasses the official release, indicating an exceptional musical performance with excellent audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly note the tape sounds better than the official release, capturing audience reactions clearly; no specific issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Transitions described as tantalizing; the band and audience were locked in, creating a high‑energy, tightly woven set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers highlight Jerry's presence and leadership on stage.
